text:
Situation: Corvale General holds 283 tablets of carvedilol 25 mg. Current use is 14.5 tablets per day, giving 19.5 days on hand. FDA's records show carvedilol is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The product label for NDC 71335247403 names Bryant Ranch Prepack as the labeler and plant (FEI 1000519407). FDA inspection 1326578 of that plant ended 2026-07-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification known 2026-10-14. Earlier inspections of the same plant include an OAI classification in 2009 and multiple VAI classifications through 2024. A Warning Letter was issued to Bryant Ranch PrePack on 2010-04-08.

Our position: Supply is limited to under three weeks. The drug is not on FDA's shortage list. The current labeler's plant has a history of regulatory findings, including a recent VAI classification. Alternate manufacturers are available but their plant locations are not identifiable from labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Advagen Pharma Limited as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Advagen Pharma Ltd as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and qualify BluePoint Laboratories as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and qualify Coupler LLC as an alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
